title: Almost My Laptop
description: Steven is about to pay off his MacBook and decides not to buy anything new. He talks about a run under blue Beijing skies, his Google and Apple stocks, options and BMO funds, and why AI can't replace language teachers or do the real work of building a business.

sentences.en: The main points in brief

sentences.zh: В э́том вы́пуске Сти́вен расска́зывает о своём но́утбуке.
sentences.en: In this episode, Steven talks about his laptop.

sentences.zh: Ско́ро он вы́платит за него́ все де́ньги.
sentences.en: Soon he will pay it off in full.

sentences.zh: Он не хо́чет покупа́ть ничего́ но́вого.
sentences.en: He doesn't want to buy anything new.

sentences.zh: У́тром над Пеки́ном бы́ло голубо́е не́бо, и Сти́вен хорошо́ побежа́л.
sentences.en: In the morning there was a blue sky over Beijing, and Steven had a good run.

sentences.zh: Пото́м он смо́трит на свои́ а́кции.
sentences.en: Then he looks at his stocks.

sentences.zh: Он говори́т об а́кциях, о бирже́вых фо́ндах и о том, почему́ ИИ не заменя́ет учителе́й.
sentences.en: He talks about stocks, exchange-traded funds, and why AI doesn't replace teachers.
This is a calm episode.
Steven often laughs at himself.
Almost My Computer

sentences.zh: В конце́ декабря́ 2024 го́да Сти́вен пошёл в магази́н Apple в своём родно́м го́роде.
sentences.en: At the end of December 2024, Steven went to an Apple store in his hometown.

sentences.zh: Он сказа́л: «Я возьму́ любо́й ноутбу́к, е́сли мо́жно купи́ть в рассро́чку».
sentences.en: He said: "I'll take any laptop if I can buy it in installments."

sentences.zh: Рассро́чка — э́то когда́ ты пла́тишь за вещь не сра́зу, а ка́ждый ме́сяц понемно́гу.
sentences.en: Installments are when you pay for something not all at once, but a little every month.
He bought a MacBook Pro.

sentences.zh: Он пла́тит за него́ о́коло 200 до́лларов в ме́сяц два го́да.
sentences.en: He has been paying about 200 dollars a month for it for two years.
The last payment is coming soon.
Then the laptop will be his.
The old laptop was from 2017.
It barely worked anymore.

sentences.zh: Но́вый ноутбу́к ма́ленький, но о́чень си́льный.
sentences.en: The new laptop is small but very powerful.

sentences.zh: Тепе́рь есть ещё бо́лее но́вые моде́ли.
sentences.en: Now there are even newer models.
They are very beautiful.

sentences.zh: Но в Кита́е Сти́вену тру́дно взять кредит.
sentences.en: But in China it's hard for Steven to get credit.
He'll have to pay with his girlfriend's card.

sentences.zh: Или отда́ть сра́зу о́коло 50 ты́сяч юаней.
sentences.en: Or pay about 50,000 yuan all at once.
Steven says: "That hurts!"
Scratches and lots of videos
Steven's laptop is no longer new.
It has scratches on it.
A rental bike.
A woman caught his briefcase.
The briefcase was in the bike's basket.
It fell to the ground.
The woman didn't even stop.
Nothing broke.
But a scratch remained.
In the classroom.

sentences.zh: Вин́ты на шка́фу оста́вили маленькую вмя́тину у разъёма для телеви́зора.
sentences.en: The screws on the cabinet left a small dent near the TV port.
Steven doesn't have a case.

sentences.zh: Ещё одна́ забо́та — ме́сто на диске.
sentences.en: Another worry is disk space.
The podcast produces 10–12 gigabytes every day.
Steven watches old videos.
In them he looks younger.

sentences.zh: Но он шу́тит: «Не знаю, ста́л ли я умне́е».
sentences.en: But he jokes: "I don't know if I've gotten any smarter."
A new phone and an old tablet

sentences.zh: Стивен спроси́л у свои́х студе́нтов про но́вый телефо́н iPhone Duo.
sentences.en: Steven asked his students about the new iPhone Duo phone.
None of them has it.

sentences.zh: О нём говоря́т не о́чень хорошо́.
sentences.en: People don't say very good things about it.

sentences.zh: Стивен то́же не купи́л бы пе́рвую моде́ль.
sentences.en: Steven wouldn't buy the first model either.
So Steven isn't buying anything.
He uses what he has.

sentences.zh: У него́ есть план­ше́т iPad Pro.
sentences.en: He has an iPad Pro tablet.

sentences.zh: Стивен купи́л его́ для монта́жа ви́део.
sentences.en: Steven bought it for video editing.

sentences.zh: Но монта́ж на нём не стал про́ще.
sentences.en: But editing on it didn't get any easier.

sentences.zh: Сейча́с план­ше́т нужен для пря́мых эфи́ров в TikTok.
sentences.en: Right now the tablet is needed for TikTok livestreams.

sentences.zh: Остально́е вре́мя он лежи́т без де́ла.
sentences.en: The rest of the time it sits idle.
Steven has to grade exams.
Blue sky and 7 kilometers

sentences.zh: Вчера́ над городом было се́рое не́бо.
sentences.en: Yesterday the sky over the city was gray.
Then the sky cleared up.
It turned blue, and the wind was blowing.

sentences.zh: Дыма и гря́зи в во́здухе совсе́м не́ было.
sentences.en: There was no smoke or dirt in the air at all.
Steven went for a run.

sentences.zh: Он пробежа́л 7 киломе́тров за 43 мину́ты и 10 секу́нд.
sentences.en: He ran 7 kilometers in 43 minutes and 10 seconds.

sentences.zh: Он записа́л бег в двух приложе́ниях: Strava и Mi Fitness.
sentences.en: He recorded the run in two apps: Strava and Mi Fitness.

sentences.zh: Кита́йская ве́рсия Mi Fitness не рабо́тает со Strava.
sentences.en: The Chinese version of Mi Fitness doesn't work with Strava.
So Steven turns on both at once.

sentences.zh: Он сам говори́т, что э́то немно́го глу́по.
sentences.en: He himself says that it's a bit silly.
Google stock and options
Google went up!
Alphabet shares rose about 3 percent.
Steven made about 300 dollars in profit.

sentences.zh: Акции Apple за оди́н день вы́росли почти́ на 5 проце́нтов.
sentences.en: Apple shares rose almost 5 percent in one day.
With Google, everything was simpler.
It had a low RSI.

sentences.zh: RSI — э́то число́, кото́рое пока́зывает, не сли́шком ли де́шево стои́т а́кция.
sentences.en: RSI is a number that shows whether a stock is too cheap.
Google's number was 20–25.
Apple's was about 40.

sentences.zh: По о́пыту Стивена, когда́ число́ ни́же 30, часто хорошо́ покупа́ть.
sentences.en: In Steven's experience, when the number is below 30, it's often a good time to buy.
You can do nothing.
You can buy the stock.
And you can also buy an option.

sentences.zh: Опцио́н — э́то биле́т, кото́рый даёт пра́во купи́ть а́кцию по́зже по за́ранее вы́бранной цене́.
sentences.en: An option is a ticket that gives you the right to buy a stock later at a price chosen in advance.

sentences.zh: Е́сли а́кция вы́росла, ты забира́ешь де́ньги и уходи́шь.
sentences.en: If the stock went up, you take the money and leave.
This is not financial advice.
It's for learning and entertainment.

sentences.zh: Стивен говори́т: «Э́то твои́ де́ньги и твоя́ пробле́ма. Не вини́ меня́».
sentences.en: Steven says: "It's your money and your problem. Don't blame me."

sentences.zh: С опцио́нами мо́жно потеря́ть все де́ньги.
sentences.en: With options you can lose all your money.

sentences.zh: Поэ́тому бери́те 1–2 проце́нта от всех свои́х де́нег, не бо́льше.
sentences.en: So use 1–2 percent of all your money, no more.
BMO funds and "smart stupidity"

sentences.zh: Е́сли вы не хоти́те изуча́ть бирж́у, про́сто покупа́йте бирже́вые фо́нды.
sentences.en: If you don't want to study the stock market, just buy exchange-traded funds.

sentences.zh: Фонд — э́то больша́я корзи́на с мно́гими а́кциями.
sentences.en: A fund is a big basket with many stocks.

sentences.zh: Стивен говори́т: «Быть глу́пым с деньга́ми не пло́хо. Гла́вное — не потеря́ть их».
sentences.en: Steven says: "Being dumb with money isn't bad. The main thing is not to lose it."

sentences.zh: Мо́жно купи́ть фонд из 500 больши́х компа́ний США.
sentences.en: You can buy a fund of the 500 biggest US companies.
There are also funds from the bank BMO.

sentences.zh: Их ме́неджеры продаю́т пра́во на покупку а́кций.
sentences.en: Their managers sell the right to buy stocks.

sentences.zh: Из-за э́того фонд пла́тит бо́льше де́нег.
sentences.en: Because of this, the fund pays out more money.
It pays every month.

sentences.zh: Вы покупа́ете фонд и идёте игра́ть в гольф.
sentences.en: You buy a fund and go play golf.
Has AI already replaced the teacher?
No.

sentences.zh: Недавно студент спросил: «Вы боитесь, что ИИ возьмёт вашу работу?»
sentences.en: Recently a student asked: "Are you afraid that AI will take your job?"
Steven isn't afraid.

sentences.zh: Он сам пробовал учиться у ИИ вместо учителей.
sentences.en: He himself tried learning from AI instead of teachers.
But it turned out strange.

sentences.zh: Он учил ИИ, как его учить.
sentences.en: He was teaching the AI how to teach him.
But he wasn't learning the language.
AI does simple work well.
It translates and writes summaries.

sentences.zh: На сайте Стивена можно нажать на китайское слово.
sentences.en: On Steven's website you can tap a Chinese word.
Then you see the pinyin and the translation.

sentences.zh: Но читает ли Стивен эти тексты каждый вечер?
sentences.en: But does Steven read these texts every evening?
No.
But is it necessary?
Yes.

sentences.zh: Он говорит студентам: «Выучить язык можете только вы сами».
sentences.en: He tells students: "Only you yourselves can learn a language."

sentences.zh: Есть ещё очень высокий уровень языка.
sentences.en: There is also a very high level of language.

sentences.zh: Это когда ты говоришь, как местный жителъ.
sentences.en: That's when you speak like a local.

sentences.zh: Тогда тебя не примут за шпиона.
sentences.en: Then they won't take you for a spy.

sentences.zh: Может быть, когда-нибудь это сделают крошечные роботы.
sentences.en: Maybe someday tiny robots will do it.

sentences.zh: Но их нет в вашем телефоне.
sentences.en: But they aren't in your phone.
Could I run a business?

sentences.zh: У Стивена в Substack было 32 читателя.
sentences.en: Steven had 32 readers on Substack.
Now there are 29.
Steven rarely writes there.

sentences.zh: Он всё время чинит свою работу с ИИ.
sentences.en: He is always fixing his AI workflow.
But he's having fun.
His Chinese is no longer improving.

sentences.zh: После истории с визой в этом году ему стало всё равно.
sentences.en: After the visa saga this year, he stopped caring.

sentences.zh: Виза — это разрешение жить в другой стране.
sentences.en: A visa is permission to live in another country.

sentences.zh: Поэтому Стивен решил лучше изучать ИИ.
sentences.en: So Steven decided to study AI instead.

sentences.zh: Стивен слушает известных людей про бизнес.
sentences.en: Steven listens to famous people talk about business.

sentences.zh: Он думает: «А хочу ли я столько встреч и ужинов?»
sentences.en: He thinks: "But do I want that many meetings and dinners?"
For one semester Steven didn't work.

sentences.zh: Он верил, что с помощью ИИ быстро заработает в интернете.
sentences.en: He believed that with the help of AI he would quickly make money online.
It didn't work out.
Steven himself is to blame for this.

sentences.zh: Теперь он кладёт каждый выпуск в папку.
sentences.en: Now he puts every episode into a folder.

sentences.zh: Claude находит там идиомы и правила.
sentences.en: Claude finds idioms and grammar rules there.

sentences.zh: Он рисует комиксы, пишет текст для Substack и ищет короткие куски видео.
sentences.en: It draws comics, writes text for Substack and looks for short video clips.
That's great.
But sales didn't go up.

sentences.zh: Стивен спрашивает: «Это настоящий продукт? Или просто красивый фокус для вечеринки?»
sentences.en: Steven asks: "Is this a real product? Or just a pretty party trick?"
The main point

sentences.zh: Ноутбук, язык или бизнес — везде одно и то же.
sentences.en: A laptop, a language or a business: it's the same everywhere.

sentences.zh: Приборы и ИИ помогают только немного.
sentences.en: Devices and AI only help a little.
You do the main work yourselves.

sentences.zh: У Стивена пока нет своего продукта.
sentences.en: Steven doesn't have his own product yet.
But he is learning.

sentences.zh: И сейчас он готов принять эту потерю.
sentences.en: And now he is ready to accept this loss.
